blockers: UNSPECIFIED_IN_SOURCE (not invented as fact): concrete MAC family -- implemented a standard GF(2^ell) a*M+k instance consistent with SI Note 2D cardinalities.

UNSPECIFIED_IN_SOURCE: exact estimators e_hat (denominator: sifted non-lost states, i.e. QBER) and l_hat (all states), strict '<' and per-sub-token vs whole-token granularity of the M(e,l) test -- both granularities implemented, per_block default; flagged INTERPRETATION.
known_limitations: Remote state preparation via SPDC entanglement is modelled as direct BB84 preparation (equivalent for the TTP's (b,B) description); multiphoton emission and photon-number structure of SI Note 3A are not simulated.
Correction's C-growing extension and n-time-secure MAC reuse are not implemented; one key per account, one token per payment.
TTP ledger is stateful (ttp_verify) while check() is the stateless D1 game predicate; a single honest TTP therefore never double-settles; D1 is about producing two valid merchant-bound cryptograms.
Peer-review concern (Reviewer 1, MOESM2): a malicious client could change its honest (l_h, e_h) profile; the protocol takes the TTP threshold as a configured parameter, which inherits that issue.
No SDP / Chernoff bound implemented (lane D).
